Heavy Rain and Storm Alerts Issued for Multiple Districts in Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh

Authorities have issued alerts for heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, and lightning in 17 districts of Madhya Pradesh and several districts of Chhattisgarh. In Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, rivers and drains are reported to be overflowing due to heavy rains, leading to the declaration of school holidays. The weather forecast indicates changing conditions across Chhattisgarh for the next five days, with warnings of heavy showers and lightning.
